# Minotaur legacy save fixture

`minotaur-v84.oysav` is a synthetic save written by the production v84 serializer
(before the v85 change; serializer source matches commit69bed40). It contains a Minotaur Lord
with Perception and no LethalStrike entry. It contains no user save or personal data.

LethalStrikeTests loads it through the v85 reader, hydrates Party, and verifies that the innate
Normal1 skill is added without losing Perception. Separate tests cover preserved existing progress,
repeated hydration and persistence of the outdoor combat-level cache in v85.

## minotaur-v04-v85.oysav

Synthetic save written by the unmodified v0.4 SaveGame writer at commit1b50dfd before
integrating upstream1.5. Generated by the innate/save regression fixture, not a user save.
Contains a Minotaur Lord with LethalStrike15 GM, Perception10 and outdoor actor effectiveLevel87.
It exercises the mod-specific v85 layout (including the old weather field).
SHA256: `5d4951c0c6668704176d5e850d1257ff1746e0f7dbe3fce1f59607c6cc20ea10`.

## Official upstream fixtures for the 1.5 rebase

`openyamm-upstream-v85.oysav` was written by the original upstream serializer at
`e56bccbda22642d089c15e0e14c15e2b866dd302`; `openyamm-upstream-1.5-v88.oysav`
by tag1.5 (`1414884155362e613977a3444a3c7f81ed4ee047`). For generation only, each
serializer was compiled in a private namespace alongside the test runner; the writer
logic and header were unchanged. These are synthetic fixtures, not user files.
Both contain a MinotaurLord without LethalStrike and actor65 at456/525HP. They have
no mod combat-level field and exercise the upstream weather layout.

openyamm-upstream-v85.oysav SHA256: `5efa5d78920020db22607a19c3a6126b8425091be0a4024b3c64cb59c6792b39`.

openyamm-upstream-1.5-v88.oysav SHA256: `308a8d4fc50b9caac8e3c3bdcda3bd8fe50210d4c6f4b068f2e674f85fbabac2`.

## minotaur-v04-progress-v85.oysav

Synthetic campaign-progress fixture written by the v0.4 serializer from commit1b50dfd.
For compilation against1.5 types only, the two retired weather member references are
bound to false/preset0; their original two-byte wire layout and every writer field/order
are unchanged. No user save or personal data is included. Covers inventory grid/quantity,
XP/level/skill points, bank/gold/food, quest bits, NPC overrides, reserve character,
visited outdoor and indoor map state. The test verifies three new-format roundtrips.
SHA256: `0f8556439aa8e79020d1a9279a57d708ef6e459a9df75994edcfdf5c05a28c4e`.
